summary: Frontend follow-up regression executed on public preview (mobile-first). Core login/home/profile ordering, macro auto-preview/save behavior, scan start-over refund flow, and subscription manage/restore routes were validated. One reproducible UI bug found at 320 dark mode in macro method sheet.

ui_bugs.issue: At 320px width in dark mode, `macro-method-close` becomes outside visible viewport and was not tappable in automation (Element is outside viewport).

issues: Bottom of method sheet content/actions can render below viewport; close action not reliably reachable at small width.

action_items: Fix `macro-method-sheet` small-screen layout so `macro-method-close` is always visible/tappable at 320 width (dark/light).
Ensure method sheet supports reliable scrolling and safe bottom inset handling on web preview/mobile viewport.
Optional testability improvement: expose stable checked-state hook for `auto-macros-toggle` to simplify automation assertions.
critical_code_review_comments: Cancelled restaurant feature remains absent in UI and API behavior; no Google/Places network calls were observed during tested flows.
Profile order is correct: subscription card renders before My Goal card.
Manage subscription and Restore purchases routes both still navigate to paywall for free plan.
seed_data_creation: No new account created. Test image fixture downloaded at /app/tests/assets/meal_scan.jpg. Note: QA scanrefund account currently shows 2 of 3 free scans left after verification reruns.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: fresh login reaches home-buddy-avatar, buddy size capped at 255 at 390/320 with no horizontal overflow, subscription before goal, scan analyze decrements usage and start-over refund restores usage, retry after forced discard network failure works, duplicate Start over sends one discard request. Restored targets to 2430/112/313/81 water 2500 and returned app to light mode.
rca_of_issue: Macro method sheet regression RCA: at 320 width + dark mode, sheet action area can render outside visible viewport; close button (`macro-method-close`) cannot always be tapped. Likely missing constrained max-height + internal scroll and/or insufficient bottom inset handling in sheet layout. Mitigation: enforce sheet body scroll container with safe-area padded footer and keep action button pinned within viewport.
